channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Last Thursday Club Night of September
item.description: Join us for a fun-filled badminton night at Claremont Stadium. Perfect for beginners and improvers, with seasoned players sharing their tips. All 4 courts are ready for action!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us for a Fun Thursday at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for a fun and pressure-free badminton session for beginners and improvers. Laughs, exercise, and potential badminton superpowers await!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night Special at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for a beginner-friendly and improver-focused evening at Claremont Stadium, filled with laughter, coaching, and a waffle lot of fun!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us for a Fun Badminton Night at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us for a beginner-friendly badminton night with coaching and fun games at Claremont Stadium. Everyone is welcome!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: The Wait is Almost Over: New Season Starts Soon!
item.description: Get ready for a brand new season with exciting games, team selections, and plenty of fun. Join us on 3rd September for the start of an exciting journey!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Our Beginners Badminton Night!
item.description: Looking for a fun way to stay active this summer? Join our Beginners Badminton night at Claremont Stadium every Wednesday!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Badminton Night at Claremont
item.description: Join us for a fun badminton night at Claremont from 9pm to 11pm, open to beginners, social members, and regulars.
